rca of the issue: Previously /office/open used absolute redirects that leaked internal host 0.0.0.0:3000. The fix in /app/frontend/src/app/office/open/route.ts now uses Next.js redirect() with relative paths only (safeTo validated to start with '/' and not '//'), so responses use relative Location headers and browsers resolve them against the current public origin. Verified: redirect chain shows only https://cashflow-pro-295.preview.emergentagent.com URLs.
